title: Global traffic jam
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do people continue driving in cities even when traffic is terrible?
Would congestion charges be fair in a large city?
Which would reduce traffic more effectively: better public transport, remote work, or restrictions on cars?
How does traffic congestion affect people beyond simply wasting time?
If your city removed half of its road space for private cars, would you support the change?
